topic: How the Anthropic Messages API, the OpenAI Responses API and the Google Gemini native API authenticate, stream text and tool calls, report usage and refuse over-window requests, and which vendors' OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints accept Moonzila's current request shape
notes: RUN 1 of 2 (Gemini native and compatible, Anthropic native and compatible, OpenAI Responses): 18 owner URLs typed P, no searches, 18 credits at depth deep. Run 2 is research/plan-2.json (14 URLs, 14 credits); research/plan-conditional.json runs only if the lead decides, on the triggers it names (at most about 12 credits). Both runs: 32 credits; worst case with the conditional plan about 44, under this project's 45-credit cap.
